reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that FeCoNi can form an L1₀ ordered structure; this ternary system is known to remain a disordered fcc solid solution and does not exhibit long-range chemical ordering, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with explicit structural and magnetic characterization and a decisive falsification criterion, though it is based on a flawed premise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it targets an ordering transition that does not occur in the specified material, so testing it would not advance the understanding of coercivity limitations in FeCoNi-based high-entropy alloys.
